people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Kir
people.line: A Moabite city, later destroyed by the Babylonians

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab, and he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and my mother come out with you, until I know what God will do for me.”
translations.bsb: From there David went to Mizpeh of Moab, where he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and mother stay with you until I learn what God will do for me.”
translations.kjv: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.
translations.asv: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.
